description: Na₂ZnH₄(SeO₅)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.93 Å. Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form ZnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.17 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.67 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.67 Å) H-O bond length. Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-58°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.67 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Zn, and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Zn, and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Se atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two H, and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, one Zn, and two H atoms.
